references.label: Three top lanes
references.description: Left-side lanes that activate and advance the yellow Double Bonus, orange Extra Ball, and red Special paths.

references.label: Path of Victory orbit
references.description: Complete right-to-left orbit whose two rollovers must register without an intervening switch hit.

references.label: Base Bonus threshold pads
references.description: Four large standups that unlock progress past 10,000, 20,000, 30,000, and 40,000 Base Bonus.

references.label: Left spinner
references.description: Spinner raised by completed top-lane sets and reset to 100 after another Path award is collected.
